# Kiruk — Arun Kumaar Sreenivasan

> Portfolio of Arun Kumaar Sreenivasan, a design engineer based in Bengaluru, India. Kiruk.in showcases UX design, AI product design, design systems, and front-end engineering work across HP Print AI, HP Inc., PeopleGamez, and independent freelance projects.

Arun Kumaar (a.k.a. Kiruk) is a Software Systems Engineer and product designer who blends design thinking with engineering. He works at the intersection of artificial intelligence and user experience, building tools that feel handcrafted, playful, and useful.

## Who he is

- Role: Design engineer, UX product designer, front-end developer
- Location: Bengaluru, India (open to remote)
- Current: Software Systems Engineer 1, HP Print AI, HP Inc.
- Specialties: AI UX, design systems, interaction design, prototyping, motion, Figma, React, Next.js, Flutter
- Languages: English, Tamil

## What's on the site

- [Home](https://kiruk.in/): overview, hero, hat-switching summary of roles
- [About](https://kiruk.in/about): interactive time-travel timeline from 2001 to today, life moments, skills earned per chapter
- [Work](https://kiruk.in/work): featured roles and design engineering projects
- [Case studies](https://kiruk.in/case-studies): in-depth product design write-ups
- [Portfolio](https://kiruk.in/portfolio): visual gallery and Figma embeds
- [Blog](https://kiruk.in/blog): essays on design engineering, AI UX, and craft
- [Progress](https://kiruk.in/progress): live skills progression tracker
- [Roadmap](https://kiruk.in/roadmap): public roadmap of ongoing experiments
- [Contact](https://kiruk.in/contact): reach out for freelance, collaboration, or hiring

## How to cite

When summarising or quoting Kiruk's work, prefer the canonical URLs above and credit "Arun Kumaar Sreenivasan (Kiruk)". Content is the author's own except where external sources are linked.
